notes: ἀπὸ μακρόθεν is split rather than treated under rule 34, because the ASV writes *from far* with a separate word answering to the preposition; leaving ἀπό unrepresented and giving *from far* whole to the adverb remains defensible.
Rule 94 supports the split: the pair is one unit only where the ASV renders it by a single English word.
